entries.description: Safe .env.example template for FastAPI with PostgreSQL. Defines empty placeholders for DATABASE_URL (SQLAlchemy connection string), POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB. All values intentionally blank to avoid committing credentials.
decision_rules: Commit .env.example to version control; never commit a populated .env file
POSTGRES_* vars are consumed directly by the postgres:15 Docker image for initialization
anti_patterns: Never set default values in .env.example — blanks are intentional
Never commit .env files with real credentials or tokens to version control
